article: Macでアプリ・個別ウィンドウをAlt+Tab風に切り替える
scope: Compared complete Japanese article and twelve translations, metadata, shortcut descriptions, current download flow, permissions, free/Pro distinction, original animation, and links against Apple and vendor primary sources.
findings: Removed duplicate future date; retained 2023-04-05 publication date and recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Corrected the claim that Mac lacks built-in app switching: Command-Tab switches apps and Command-grave switches windows in the current app.
Updated obsolete netlify.app link to alt-tab.app and clarified Option-Tab is the current default; remapping to Command-Tab replaces the native shortcut.
Explained Accessibility permission for switching, Screen Recording for thumbnails, and operation without thumbnails if denied.
Clarified core features are free while Pro features are separately paid; linked current terms and privacy policy.
Updated and aligned all twelve translations.

post/macでWindowsライク（Alt+Tab）にアプリケーション切り替.source: post/macでWindowsライク（Alt+Tab）にアプリケーション切り替えする方法/index.md
post/macでWindowsライク（Alt+Tab）にアプリケーション切り替.summary: Compared the full Japanese source and twelve translations with Apple shortcut documentation and AltTab official setup, FAQ, privacy policy, and terms. Corrected the false claim that macOS lacks app switching, updated the official download domain, and documented default Option-Tab, permissions, thumbnail behavior, and free versus Pro features.

meaning.note: Compared built-in app switching, same-app window switching, AltTab window-level behavior, default shortcut, and Command-Tab remapping caveat across locales.

terminology.note: Checked Command-Tab, Command-grave, Option-Tab, Accessibility, Screen Recording, thumbnails, free core tier, and Pro terminology against Apple and vendor documentation.

links.note: Replaced obsolete netlify.app URL and added official AltTab site, FAQ, privacy policy, terms, and Apple shortcut documentation.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
No macOS device test was performed; permission labels and application screens can vary by macOS version, and the original animation may show an earlier interface.

AltTab is a third-party application requiring Accessibility access and optionally Screen Recording access for thumbnails; review the current permission prompts and vendor policy before granting access.
